SocialSchemeResource.title: SocialSchemeResource
SocialSchemeResource.description: Network-agnostic generic layer. Models a government or social-sector benefit scheme as a catalogue Resource: what the scheme is, who is eligible, what documents are required, and what the benefit consists of. Inherits from Beckn core Resource. The ION-specific layer (IONSocialSchemeResource) extends this via allOf and carries Indonesian regulatory fields.

IONSocialSchemeResource.description:
Indonesia-specific layer for a social welfare / government scheme
resource. This is the CATALOGUE item — it describes the scheme, its
eligibility rules, required documents, and disbursement mechanism.
Per-applicant eligibility outcome lives in Commitment/Performance;
the case record lives in Contract.

crc.description: Catalogue Resource Category. Fixed at SVC-social for every resource using this schema. Declared explicitly (rather than only inferred) so ONIX and CNs can filter without parsing the full attribute bag.

requiredDocuments.description: Checklist of documents an applicant must produce to apply for this scheme. Each entry names the document category and whether it is mandatory or conditional.

indonesianCompliance.description: Present on every resource published on ION Indonesia. Carries the Indonesia-specific eligibility data-source, verification, and disbursement-channel fields that have no meaning outside this regulatory context.

SchemeIdentity.description: Identity and classification of the scheme — what it is called, who administers it, and what kind of benefit it delivers.

schemeName.description: Official scheme name as registered with the implementing ministry or agency. Should match the name used in the scheme's legal establishing instrument (Permensos, Perpres, Perda) exactly.

schemeCode.description: Government or registry-assigned scheme code, where one exists (e.g. a DTKS programme code or a provincial social-assistance registry code). Optional — many local (Perda-level) schemes have no centrally issued code.

implementingAgency.description: Full legal name of the government ministry, agency, or local government body that owns and funds the scheme.

implementingAgencyLevel.description: Administrative level at which the implementing agency sits.

schemeLevel.description: Administrative scope at which the scheme is offered.

schemeType.description: The kind of benefit this scheme delivers to a beneficiary.

fundingModel.description: Source of funds backing the scheme.

sectorTags.description: Free-standing thematic tags describing the domain the scheme serves. Used for discovery filtering; not a regulatory classification.

officialReferenceUrl.description: Link to the scheme's official government description page, if published.

Eligibility.description: Structured eligibility rules for the scheme. Each criterion is expressed as a discrete, machine-evaluable rule rather than free text, so a Buyer App can pre-screen an applicant before submission.

targetBeneficiaryTypes.description: Categories of applicant this scheme is open to.

demographicCriteria.description: Age, gender, marital, or household-composition rules.

economicCriteria.description: Income, employment, land-ownership, or asset-based rules.

occupationalCriteria.description: Occupation or livelihood-sector rules (e.g. farmer, fisherfolk, informal worker).

priorityGroups.description: Population groups the scheme gives selection priority to, when demand exceeds allocation. Informational — does not itself gate eligibility.

eligibilitySummary.description: Human-readable prose summary of eligibility, for display in a Buyer App and for cases the structured rules above do not fully capture. Should restate, not replace, the structured criteria.
eligibilitySummary.example: Rumah tangga miskin dan rentan yang terdaftar dalam DTKS, memiliki komponen kesehatan (balita/ibu hamil), pendidikan (anak usia sekolah), atau kesejahteraan sosial (lansia/disabilitas berat).

EligibilityRule.description: A single machine-evaluable eligibility rule: a named criterion, a comparison operator, and the qualifying value.

ruleId.description: Stable identifier for this criterion, unique within the scheme.

operator.description: Comparison operator applied between the applicant's declared value and `value`.

value.description: Qualifying value or list of values. Type depends on the criterion.

unit.description: Unit for numeric values, when applicable (e.g. IDR, YEARS, HECTARES).

GeographicEligibility.description: Geographic scope within which applicants must reside to be eligible.

residencyRequired.description: Whether the applicant's KTP domicile must fall within applicableProvinces/applicableKabupaten.

applicableProvinces.description: BPS province codes where the scheme is available. Empty array means nationwide.

applicableKabupatenKota.description: BPS kabupaten/kota codes, for schemes scoped narrower than province level.

domicileMatchBasis.description: Which document determines the applicant's domicile for eligibility purposes.

Benefit.description: What the beneficiary receives, and on what schedule.

benefitForm.description: The physical or financial form the benefit takes.

benefitAmount.description: Fixed or maximum benefit amount, when the benefit is monetary.

benefitAmountBasis.description: How the amount in benefitAmount is determined, when it is not a flat fixed sum.

disbursementFrequency.description: How often the benefit is disbursed, for recurring schemes.

benefitDescription.description: Prose description of what the beneficiary receives, including any component breakdown (e.g. health/education/social-welfare components of PKH). Long-form detail belongs in the Beckn Descriptor.longDesc; this field holds the short structured summary only.
benefitDescription.example: Bantuan tunai bersyarat per komponen keluarga penerima manfaat

MonetaryAmount.description: Reusable monetary amount object with value and currency.

RequiredDocument.description: A single document an applicant must produce.

purpose.description: What the document proves (proof of identity, proof of residency, proof of income, etc.).

mandatory.description: False for conditionally required documents (e.g. only if claiming a disability priority).

conditionRuleId.description: If mandatory is false, the ruleId (from Eligibility.*Criteria) that triggers the requirement for this document.

ApplicationChannel.description: How and where an eligible applicant applies for this scheme.

applicationMode.description: Primary application mode. FACILITATED means the ION Seller App's own agent/caseworker submits on the applicant's behalf — the pattern used by scheme-facilitation partners. SELF_SERVICE means the applicant completes the application themselves through a government portal that the Seller App links out to.

governmentPortalUrl.description: Official application portal URL, when one exists.

applicationWindow.description: Whether applications are accepted year-round or only in defined windows.

processingTimeEstimate.description: ISO 8601 duration estimate from application submission to decision, for applicant expectation-setting.

SchemeValidity.description: The period during which this scheme catalogue entry is accurate and applications are accepted.

requiresAnnualReverification.description: Whether an approved beneficiary must reverify eligibility each year to keep receiving the benefit.

FundingSource.description: Budget line and fiscal-year detail behind the scheme, where publicly disclosed.

budgetLineReference.description: Government budget line item reference (APBN/APBD line), where publicly disclosed.

cofundingAgencies.description: Additional agencies co-funding the scheme, for centrally-sponsored programmes.

IndonesianComplianceBlock.description: Indonesia-specific data-source, verification, and disbursement fields. These have no meaning outside the Indonesian social-welfare regulatory context and therefore live only in the ION-specific layer, never the generic layer.

dtksReference.description: Whether eligibility for this scheme is cross-checked against DTKS (Data Terpadu Kesejahteraan Sosial) per Permensos 5/2019.

dtksDecileRequirement.description: Qualifying DTKS welfare decile(s), when the scheme gates on DTKS ranking.

nikVerificationRequired.description: Whether the applicant's NIK must be verified against Dukcapil population data before submission.

kksRequired.description: Whether the applicant must hold or be issued a Kartu Keluarga Sejahtera (KKS) to receive disbursement.

disbursementChannel.description: How the benefit is physically disbursed to the beneficiary, per Perpres 63/2017 non-cash disbursement policy.

dataResidency.description: Beneficiary personal and welfare data arising from this scheme must remain on Indonesian soil per UU PDP 2022 and sectoral regulation for social-protection data.

regulatoryBasis.description: Legal instruments establishing or governing this scheme.
